rules.description: Asserts the latest observation date reaches at least 2022 and freshness lag is between 0 and 3 years for Count_BirthEvent_LiveBirth.

params.query: SELECT CAST(MAX(MaxDate) AS INTEGER) AS latest_year, date_part('year', current_date) - CAST(MAX(MaxDate) AS INTEGER) AS lag_years FROM stats WHERE StatVar = 'Count_BirthEvent_LiveBirth'
params.condition: latest_year IS NOT NULL AND latest_year >= 2022 AND lag_years BETWEEN 0 AND 3

rules.description: Asserts active 2022+ maternal, infant health, and demographic StatVars share a uniform latest observation date.

params.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MaxDate) AS distinct_dates, COUNT(DISTINCT StatVar) AS active_statvar_count FROM stats WHERE CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= 2022 OR StatVar IN ('Count_BirthEvent_LiveBirth', 'Mean_MothersAge_BirthEvent_LiveBirth', 'Mean_OeGestationalAge_BirthEvent_LiveBirth', 'Mean_LmpGestationalAge_BirthEvent_LiveBirth', 'Mean_BirthWeight_BirthEvent_LiveBirth', 'Mean_PrePregnancyBMI_BirthEvent_LiveBirth', 'Mean_PrenatalVisitCount_BirthEvent_LiveBirth', 'Mean_IntervalSinceLastBirth_BirthEvent_LiveBirth', 'Mean_IntervalSinceLastPregnancyOutcomeNotLiveBirth_BirthEvent_LiveBirth')

rules.description: Checks that the percentage of deleted points is within threshold after filtering out 0.0 placeholder rows on Not Available slices.
